title: Technology Sector Update for 10/02/2018: MLNX,ESLT,APH,BABA
text:

CSCO +0.33%
GOOG +0.54%
Technology stocks still were firming Tuesday afternoon, with the shares of tech stocks in the S&P 500 adding nearly 0.5% in value while the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index was holding on to a 0.3% advance.
Among technology stocks moving on news:
(+) Mellanox Technologies ( MLNX ) climbed almost 9% at one point on Tuesday after analysts at Jefferies began coverage of the fabless chipmaker with a Buy stock rating and a $110 price target.
In other sector news:
(+) Elbit Systems ( ESLT ) roe over 1% on Tuesday after the electronic warfare and signal intelligence company said its UK subsidiary has received a contract worth around $13 million from the UK Ministry of Defense. Under the deal, the company will provide the British Army with an operationally proven battle management application for both headquarters and tactical units, based on TORC2 H, the company's command and control platform.
(-) Amphenol ( APH ) has turned narrowly lower Tuesday afternoon, drifting off a fractional gain earlier in the session. The electronic components company overnight priced a EUR500 million ($576.8 million) offering of 2.00% senior notes due 2028 at 99.498% of par. Net proceeds will be used to repay existing debt and for general working capital.
(-) Alibaba ( BABA ) was down about 1% in afternoon trading reports the Chinese internet company is looking to partner with Indian retailers as it expands its cloud technology and "new retail" concepts to additional markets. According to the Economic Times, Alibaba expects to deploy its augmented reality technology during retail events, such as Single's Day, to improve customer experience.
